sentiment.instructions: Which emotional tone dominates this text?

positive.description: Pleasant emotions such as joy, amusement, love, pride or relief dominate the text, or the author approves of something.
examples: Not even 20 pages into Paper Towns and the book centers around the night of May 5th. I know its gonna be a good one now!

neutral.description: No emotion dominates, and the tone is calm, matter-of-fact or impersonal.
examples: I may be sleep deprived but I promise you that some kid at Dunkin today looked like a sprout.

negative.description: Unpleasant emotions such as anger, sadness, fear, disgust or frustration dominate the text, or the author disapproves of something.
examples: The tragedy of only thinking up hilarious tweets for the Summer Olympics now is that in four years there may be no place for them.
